paper_title: The metamorphosis of semi-classical mechanisms of confinement: from monopoles on R^3 x S^1 to center-vortices on R^2 x T^2 (Guvendik, 2024, JHEP)
deeper_reasoning_1:
\noindent\textbf{Claim.} The monopole and vortex quantum-mechanical limits have the same infrared content precisely because, after subtracting the regime-dependent zero-point energy, both are the same cyclic tunnelling Hamiltonian. Let $X\in\{M,V\}$ denote the monopole and vortex regimes. If
\[
H_X=E_XI_X-\kappa e^{-i\theta/N}T_X-\kappa e^{i\theta/N}T_X^\dagger,
\qquad \kappa:=K e^{-S_I/N}>0,
\]
acts on $N$ cyclic vacua, then the electric-flux branches are
\[
\varepsilon_{X,k}(\theta):=N(E_{X,k}(\theta)-E_X)
=-2NK e^{-S_I/N}\cos\left(\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right),
\qquad k=0,\ldots,N-1.
\]
Consequently the magnetic-flux basis $\{|\nu_i\rangle\}$ and the holonomy basis $\{|m\rangle\}$ are two labels for the same deformed one-dimensional $Z_N$ topological theory, up to an additive energy constant.

\noindent\textbf{Premises.}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathrm{(P1)}&\quad N\geq2,
\quad \omega:=e^{2\pi i/N},
\quad \omega^N=1,
\quad S_I=8\pi^2/g^2.\\
\mathrm{(P2)}&\quad X\in\{M,V\},
\quad \{|r\rangle_X\}_{r=0}^{N-1}\text{ is an orthonormal cyclic basis,}
\quad |N\rangle_X:=|0\rangle_X.\\
\mathrm{(P3)}&\quad T_X:=\sum_{r=0}^{N-1}|r\rangle_X\langle r+1|_X.\\
\mathrm{(P4)}&\quad H_X=E_XI_X-\kappa e^{-i\theta/N}T_X-\kappa e^{i\theta/N}T_X^\dagger,
\quad \kappa:=K e^{-S_I/N}.\\
\mathrm{(P5)}&\quad |e_k\rangle_X:=N^{-1/2}\sum_{r=0}^{N-1}\omega^{-kr}|r\rangle_X,
\quad k=0,\ldots,N-1.\\
\mathrm{(P6)}&\quad \text{The monopole endpoint uses }|r\rangle_M=|\nu_{r+1}\rangle,
\text{ and the vortex endpoint uses }|r\rangle_V=|m=r\rangle.\\
\mathrm{(P7)}&\quad e^{ix}+e^{-ix}=2\cos x.
\end{aligned}
\]

\noindent\textbf{Derivation.}
For any basis vector,
\begin{align}
T_X|j\rangle_X
&=\sum_{r=0}^{N-1}|r\rangle_X\langle r+1|j\rangle_X && \text{by (P3)},\\
&=|j-1\rangle_X && \text{cyclic indexing}.
\end{align}
Therefore
\begin{align}
T_X|e_k\rangle_X
&=N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\omega^{-kj}T_X|j\rangle_X && \text{by (P5)},\\
&=N^{-1/2}\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}\omega^{-kj}|j-1\rangle_X && \text{previous line},\\
&=N^{-1/2}\sum_{\ell=0}^{N-1}\omega^{-k(\ell+1)}|\ell\rangle_X && \text{set }\ell=j-1,\\
&=\omega^{-k}|e_k\rangle_X. && \text{factor out }\omega^{-k}
\end{align}
Since $T_X^\dagger|e_k\rangle_X=\omega^k|e_k\rangle_X$, the Hamiltonian satisfies
\begin{align}
H_X|e_k\rangle_X
&=\left(E_X-\kappa e^{-i\theta/N}\omega^{-k}-\kappa e^{i\theta/N}\omega^k\right)|e_k\rangle_X && \text{by (P4)},\\
&=\left(E_X-\kappa e^{-i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}-\kappa e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}\right)|e_k\rangle_X && \text{by (P1)},\\
&=\left(E_X-2K e^{-S_I/N}\cos\left(\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right)\right)|e_k\rangle_X && \text{by (P7)}.
\end{align}
Thus
\begin{align}
\varepsilon_{X,k}(\theta)
&=N(E_{X,k}(\theta)-E_X) && \text{definition},\\
&=-2NK e^{-S_I/N}\cos\left(\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right). && \text{substitute the eigenvalue}
\end{align}
Finally, define $U|r\rangle_M:=|r\rangle_V$. Then $UT_MU^\dagger=T_V$, hence
\begin{align}
U(H_M-E_MI_M)U^\dagger&=H_V-E_VI_V && \text{same }\kappa,\theta,N\text{ in (P4)}.
\end{align}
This proves equality of the two theta-dependent branch spectra and leaves only the additive constants $E_M$ and $E_V$.

\noindent\textbf{Final Result.}
\[
\boxed{\varepsilon_{M,k}(\theta)=\varepsilon_{V,k}(\theta)=-2NK e^{-S_I/N}\cos\left(\frac{\theta+2\pi k}{N}\right),
\qquad k=0,\ldots,N-1.}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$

deeper_reasoning_1.title: Cyclic Hamiltonian normal form for the shared one-dimensional infrared theory
deeper_reasoning_1.goal_alignment: Directly proves the shared N-vacuum cyclic Hamiltonian and theta-dependent branch spectrum required by G1.
deeper_reasoning_1.scientific_payoff: Converts separate monopole and vortex Hamiltonian calculations into a single quotient-equivalence statement.
deeper_reasoning_1.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds an explicit unitary identification between the magnetic-flux and holonomy bases.
deeper_reasoning_1.formal_sharpness: Specifies the cyclic basis, shift operator, tunnelling phase, Fourier eigenbasis, branch normalization, and additive-energy quotient.
deeper_reasoning_1.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids a one-sided repetition of the monopole branch formula.
controlled_external_lemmas: Discrete Fourier diagonalization of a finite cyclic shift
deeper_reasoning_1.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: Equality of the prefactor K is treated as the goal-level common semiclassical amplitude, not independently computed.

deeper_reasoning_2.title: Energy hierarchy and finite-volume crossover compatibility
deeper_reasoning_2.goal_alignment: Shows why the two semiclassical regimes occupy opposite size limits while remaining compatible with a finite-volume crossover.
deeper_reasoning_2.scientific_payoff: Connects the energy comparison to the paper's claim that no separate confining phase transition is required in the compactified setup.
deeper_reasoning_2.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds a finite-dimensional partition-function argument rather than only restating the energy ratio.
deeper_reasoning_2.formal_sharpness: States the positivity and finite-matrix assumptions under which crossover language is justified.
deeper_reasoning_2.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids overclaiming adiabatic continuity for uncontrolled strongly coupled R4 Yang-Mills.
controlled_external_lemmas: Continuity and analyticity of finite matrix exponentials
deeper_reasoning_2.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: A genuine thermodynamic-limit statement is not asserted; the result is restricted to finite R x T3 quantum mechanics.

deeper_reasoning_3.goal_alignment: Derives the G2 chain from twisted modes to locked vacua, vortex fugacity, S_IR, and branch densities.
deeper_reasoning_3.scientific_payoff: Explains why the monopole gas becomes a two-dimensional vortex deformation instead of a Coulomb gas.
deeper_reasoning_3.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Combines the mode gap, root phases, monopole insertion, and TQFT branch derivation into one operational bridge.

controlled_external_lemmas: Fourier quantization under twisted boundary conditions
deeper_reasoning_3.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The derivation is explicitly limited to ell_D >> L2 >> L3 and does not claim validity outside the scale-separated vortex regime.

deeper_reasoning_4.title: Center-vortex diagnostics from screening and Wilson-loop fractionalization
deeper_reasoning_4.goal_alignment: Proves the short-range interaction scale, center-vortex Wilson phase, and charge-loop area law required by G2.
deeper_reasoning_4.scientific_payoff: Provides the operational evidence that the fractionalized monopole flux is detected as a center vortex.
deeper_reasoning_4.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Unifies three separate diagnostics into one criterion for vortex identification.
